theory Federation_Key_Rotation

// Function signature and definition of the equational theory E

functions: fst/1, pair/2, pk/1, sign/2, snd/1, true/0, verify/3
equations:
    fst(<x.1, x.2>) = x.1,
    snd(<x.1, x.2>) = x.2,
    verify(sign(x.1, x.2), x.1, pk(x.2)) = true

restriction Unique:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Unique( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Unique( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  // safety formula

  /*
  expanded formula:
  "∀ x #i #j. ((Unique( x ) @ #i) ∧ (Unique( x ) @ #j)) ⇒ (#i = #j)"
  */

rule (modulo E) IdP_Init:
   [ Fr( ~sk ) ]
  --[
  IdP_Key_Created( $IdP, pk(~sk), 'initial' ), Key_Active( $IdP, pk(~sk) ),
  Unique( <'idp_init', $IdP> )
  ]->
   [
   !IdP_SK( $IdP, ~sk ), !IdP_PK( $IdP, pk(~sk) ),
   IdP_Active_Key( $IdP, pk(~sk) ), Out( pk(~sk) )
   ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Reveal_Key:
   [ !IdP_SK( $IdP, sk ) ] --[ Revealed( $IdP ) ]-> [ Out( sk ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) IdP_Rotate_Key:
   [ IdP_Active_Key( $IdP, old_pk ), Fr( ~new_sk ) ]
  --[
  Key_Rotated( $IdP, old_pk, pk(~new_sk) ),
  Key_Active( $IdP, pk(~new_sk) ), Key_Retired( $IdP, old_pk ),
  IdP_Key_Created( $IdP, pk(~new_sk), 'rotation' ),
  Unique( <'rotate', $IdP, pk(~new_sk)> )
  ]->
   [
   !IdP_SK( $IdP, ~new_sk ), !IdP_PK( $IdP, pk(~new_sk) ),
   IdP_Active_Key( $IdP, pk(~new_sk) ), Out( pk(~new_sk) )
   ]

  // loop breaker: [0]
  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) IdP_Issue_Token:
   [ !IdP_SK( $IdP, sk ), IdP_Active_Key( $IdP, pk(sk) ), Fr( ~nonce ) ]
  --[
  Token_Issued( $IdP, sign(<'id_token', $IdP, $aud, $User, ~nonce>, sk),
                pk(sk), $User, ~nonce
  ),
  Signed_With_Key( $IdP, sign(<'id_token', $IdP, $aud, $User, ~nonce>, sk),
                   pk(sk)
  ),
  IdP_Key_Used( $IdP, pk(sk) )
  ]->
   [
   IdP_Active_Key( $IdP, pk(sk) ),
   Out( sign(<'id_token', $IdP, $aud, $User, ~nonce>, sk) )
   ]

  // loop breaker: [1]
  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Broker_Register_JWKS:
   [ !IdP_PK( $IdP, idp_pk ) ]
  --[ JWKS_Registered( $Broker, $IdP, idp_pk ) ]->
   [ !Broker_JWKS( $Broker, $IdP, idp_pk ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

rule (modulo E) Broker_Verify:
   [
   In( sign(<'id_token', $IdP, broker_id, $User, nonce>, sk) ),
   !Broker_JWKS( broker_id, $IdP, pk(sk) )
   ]
  --[
  Token_Verified( broker_id, $IdP,
                  sign(<'id_token', $IdP, broker_id, $User, nonce>, sk), pk(sk), $User
  )
  ]->
   [ Broker_Authenticated( broker_id, $IdP, $User ) ]

  /* has exactly the trivial AC variant */

lemma idp_key_was_active [reuse, use_induction]:
  all-traces
  "∀ idp pk #i.
    (IdP_Key_Used( idp, pk ) @ #i) ⇒
    (∃ #j. (Key_Active( idp, pk ) @ #j) ∧ ((#j < #i) ∨ (#j = #i)))"

guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ idp pk #i.
  (IdP_Key_Used( idp, pk ) @ #i)
 ∧
  ∀ #j. (Key_Active( idp, pk ) @ #j) ⇒ (¬(#j < #i)) ∧ (¬(#j = #i))"
*/
by sorry

  all-traces
  "∀ broker idp token pk user #i.
    (Token_Verified( broker, idp, token, pk, user ) @ #i) ⇒
    ((∃ nonce #j. Token_Issued( idp, token, pk, user, nonce ) @ #j) ∨
     (∃ #c. Revealed( idp ) @ #c))"

guarded formula characterizing all counter-examples:
"∃ broker idp token pk user #i.

 ∧

  (∀ #c. (Revealed( idp ) @ #c) ⇒ ⊥)"
*/
by sorry
